apps.name: VLC media player

mechanism.notes: REG_SZ. winvlc.c reads it at start-up and exports LANG=co before libvlc_new; the Qt Preferences > Interface > Language combo writes the same value ('Corsu' is in the list since 3.0.9). 'auto' or absent = system language. --language on the command line overrides it.

darwinvlc.m reads the app preference 'language' (CFPreferencesCopyAppValue) and exports LANG=co; the Simple Preferences 'Language' popup writes the same key. Command: defaults write org.videolan.vlc language co. AppleLanguages is NOT what VLC uses for its gettext UI.

No language option on Linux (the Qt combo is hidden when not _WIN32). gettext ignores LANGUAGE when the locale is C/POSIX, so LANG must be a real locale (e.g. fr_FR.UTF-8). Debian puts the catalog in vlc-l10n, which must be installed.
flatpak override --user --env=LANGUAGE=co:fr org.videolan.VLC. The .Locale extension only contains configured languages: flatpak config --user --set extra-languages co, then flatpak update.

mechanism.location: desktop override calling 'env LANGUAGE=co:fr snap run vlc' (?)
mechanism.notes: No per-user env override facility for snaps; untested (?)

catalog.licence: GPL-2.0-or-later (po header: 'distributed under the same license as the VLC package')

windows.version_checked: 3.10 (Poedit-3.10-setup.exe installed silently with Wine in a container: Translations\co\poedit.mo, 1089 messages, as many as fr; Poedit.exe itself does not start under Wine: missing Windows icu.dll)

Can be set before the first start. Corsu leaves a value the person changed since. Not checked on a real Windows (fixtures only).

macos.version_checked: 3.10 (Poedit-3.10.zip: Poedit.app/Contents/Resources/co.lproj/poedit.mo, 1089 messages; bundle id net.poedit.Poedit; not sandboxed)

mechanism.notes: No in-app choice (NEED_CHOOSELANG_UI is 0; no ui_language string in the 3.10 binary): Poedit follows the language list macOS gives the app (System Settings > General > Language & Region > Applications). Corsu does not write it: its preference helper only writes strings, AppleLanguages is an array. Not checked on a Mac (?).

linux.version_checked: Debian 13 poedit + poedit-common 3.6.3-2 (wxWidgets 3.2.8), run for real in a container; Flathub net.poedit.Poedit stable .Locale has co (736 messages), not run

mechanism.key: LANGUAGE, LANG, LC_MESSAGES (+ LC_ALL emptied when set; LC_CTYPE/NUMERIC/TIME/COLLATE/MONETARY/PAPER/MEASUREMENT = the session's locale)
mechanism.notes: No in-app choice on Linux. wxWidgets 3.2 puts the language of LC_ALL/LC_MESSAGES/LANG before LANGUAGE (a C locale counts as none), so LANGUAGE alone keeps French in a French session (seen). A co_FR locale does not exist in glibc and breaks the C++ locale ('locale::facet::_S_create_c_locale name not valid', seen). GTK's own dialogs then show English. ~/.config/poedit/config (wxFileConfig, rewritten on exit) is never touched.
Needs the co .Locale subset: flatpak config --user --set extra-languages co, then flatpak update. Not run (fixtures only).
